preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= 1000000000 for L, R in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, L and R are integers between 1 and 1,000,000,000, inclusive, and L is less than or equal to R.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(sum(number * len(str(number)) for number in range(L, R + 1)) % 1000000007) for L, R in test_cases)
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the goodness of all integers from L to R, inclusive, for each test case, modulo 1,000,000,007.
